extracted.name: Wedge Salad on a Stick
extracted.description: This mini wedge salad is made of lettuce wedges, bacon, and tomatoes that are threaded onto a bamboo toothpick and topped with blue cheese dressing.
ingredient_lines: 4 strips cooked bacon, cut in half
8 teaspoons crumbled blue cheese, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Thread each lettuce wedge, bacon piece, and grape tomato onto each toothpick, respectively. Arrange toothpicks on a serving platter. Drizzle 1 teaspoon blue cheese dressing over each and sprinkle with blue cheese.
